request.message:
ieops#1009: feature(topology): carry per-GPU NVLink and NUMA onto the VNode

Phase B, the transport hop. Phase A made brslet collect a per-card peer graph
and NUMA node through a gpu-topo child process, but nothing carried it further:
status.gpus[] was still N copies of GPU 0, so the three fields ieops-core gained
had no writer at all.

vk-node now projects the topology half of the static GPU list<truncated 2443 chars>
